title: 手持ち丸のこ
description: 建築保守・木工作業台向けの携帯丸のこ。実スロット付きの靴板、固定した歯付き円形刃、上部・下部ガード、横向きモーター、開いた主ハンドルと前方つまみ、支持金具と固定調整レバーを造形。刃は浅い固定姿勢で、材料や切粉はありません。既存据置タイルソーと異なる木工作業用の手持ち外形で、一式1点です。切断・回転・ガード退避・調整や実用品安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.255 × 0.279 × 0.370 m、6,752三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A portable circular-saw prop for building-maintenance and woodworking benches, with genuinely slotted shoe, fixed toothed circular blade, upper/lower guard exteriors, transverse motor, open main handle and front knob, supports and static adjustment levers. The blade is in one shallow fixed pose; no workpiece or chips are included. Its handheld woodworking form differs from the existing stationary tile saw; the complete tool counts once. Cutting, rotation, guard retraction, adjustment and real equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.255 × 0.279 × 0.370 m; 6,752 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
